006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import java.util.LinkedList;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.concurrent.locks.Lock;
011
012import dev.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
013import dev.metaschema.core.util.CollectionUtil;
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
015
016/**
017 * Represents a container of rules constraining the effective model of a
018 * Metaschema assembly data instance.
019 */
020public class AssemblyConstraintSet
021    extends ValueConstraintSet
022    implements IModelConstrained {
023
024  @NonNull
025  private final List<IIndexConstraint> indexConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
026  @NonNull
027  private final List<IUniqueConstraint> uniqueConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
028  @NonNull
029  private final List<ICardinalityConstraint> cardinalityConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
030
031  /**
032   * Construct a new constraint set.
033   *
034   * @param source
035   *          information about the resource the constraints were loaded from
036   */
037  public AssemblyConstraintSet(@NonNull ISource source) {
038    super(source);
039  }
040
041  @Override
042  public List<IIndexConstraint> getIndexConstraints() {
043    Lock readLock = getLock().readLock();
044    readLock.lock();
045    try {
046      return CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(indexConstraints);
047    } finally {
048      readLock.unlock();
049    }
050  }
051
052  @Override
053  public List<IUniqueConstraint> getUniqueConstraints() {
054    Lock readLock = getLock().readLock();
055    readLock.lock();
056    try {
057      return CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(uniqueConstraints);
058    } finally {
059      readLock.unlock();
060    }
061  }
062
063  @Override
064  public List<ICardinalityConstraint> getHasCardinalityConstraints() {
065    Lock readLock = getLock().readLock();
066    readLock.lock();
067    try {
068      return CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(cardinalityConstraints);
069    } finally {
070      readLock.unlock();
071    }
072  }
073
074  @Override
075  public final void addConstraint(@NonNull IIndexConstraint constraint) {
076    Lock writeLock = getLock().writeLock();
077    writeLock.lock();
078    try {
079      getConstraintsInternal().add(constraint);
080      indexConstraints.add(constraint);
081    } finally {
082      writeLock.unlock();
083    }
084  }
085
086  @Override
087  public final void addConstraint(@NonNull IUniqueConstraint constraint) {
088    Lock writeLock = getLock().writeLock();
089    writeLock.lock();
090    try {
091      getConstraintsInternal().add(constraint);
092      uniqueConstraints.add(constraint);
093    } finally {
094      writeLock.unlock();
095    }
096  }
097
098  @Override
099  public final void addConstraint(@NonNull ICardinalityConstraint constraint) {
100    Lock writeLock = getLock().writeLock();
101    writeLock.lock();
102    try {
103      getConstraintsInternal().add(constraint);
104      cardinalityConstraints.add(constraint);
105    } finally {
106      writeLock.unlock();
107    }
108  }
109}
